_comment: Meowy observer egg (same as egg.yaml, as JSON for the API import).
name: Meowy Observer
author: catualus@yahoo.com
description: Meowy Network's observer: a real Garry's Mod client (native Linux) under the Steam client on a virtual display. It visits servers Meowy Network's crawler suspects of faking their player count, counts who stood still for 10 minutes, and reports the counts.

variables.name: Observer token
variables.description: The same value as SERVER_REP_OBSERVER_TOKEN in the website backend's .env.

variables.name: Display password
variables.description: Password for the browser view of the virtual display (for the one-time Steam login). Empty turns the view off.

variables.name: Backend
variables.description: Where to ask for visits and send counts.
